answer: Cross-epoch witness quorum. Each identity must be independently corroborated in three consecutive epochs by distinct peers that co-sign its action log; a comet of activity signatures alone doesn't qualify. A sybil farm must recruit separate corroborators per clone, and any cluster sharing corroborators across epochs is collapsed, voiding all identities in the juniper set. Attackers pay orchestration cost proportional to clones squared, since each clone needs an isolating grove of witnesses that never overlaps another's.
